evidence_refs: GitHub Docs: REST API endpoints for Git commits — Create a commit permits caller-specified author/committer date (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/git/commits)
issue_ledger.exact_failure: scripts/check_lane_liveness.py treats GitHub's commit.committer.date as trustworthy receipt creation time and passes an after-deadline receipt whenever that date is at or before the frozen deadline. GitHub's Create a commit API explicitly permits the caller to provide author/committer date. Therefore a receipt created or pushed after the deadline can carry a backdated committer timestamp and be classified RUN_OBSERVED instead of RUN_LATE/RUN_TIMING_UNKNOWN. The code records committer_login but does not source-bind or otherwise validate the timestamp.
issue_ledger.next_action: MM06/BIL00 independently confirm the timing-source defect. If confirmed, deny Gen10 clean-cohort credit, keep/reset the v2.5 streak at zero, repair the liveness timing authority in a new immutable protocol-2.5 generation, and rerun cohort 1.
issue_ledger.proposed_protocol_2_5_fix_test: Do not use Git author/committer timestamps as authoritative liveness evidence. Preserve pre-deadline direct observation as sufficient, but for an after-deadline poll require a server-generated, source-bound timestamp that the worker cannot choose, such as a trusted GitHub Actions/check/status event created for the exact report head by the expected GitHub App, or a trusted monitor receipt persisted before deadline. Treat commit author/committer dates as informational only.
issue_ledger.required_test: Add a regression where the report is first observed after the deadline, the Git commit committer date is backdated to before the deadline, and no trusted server-time witness exists; the result MUST be RUN_TIMING_UNKNOWN or RUN_LATE and transition_liveness_pass=false. Add paired tests where an expected-source server-time witness before deadline passes and a witness after deadline blocks.
issue_ledger.summary: After-deadline receipt timing trusts a Git commit timestamp whose value can be selected by the commit creator.
